verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists "Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)" as a product feature, so MSI-based fleet rollout is a first-party capability. The evidence is only a single feature-list line, with no documentation of how preset configuration, silent-install switches or MDM-based distribution of the client work. Missing for 10: documented preset configuration/policy embedding in the MSI, documented silent-install parameters, MDM deployment of the client, in-depth deployment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
